home.name: Home, family and creator routine
home.value: Character development and repeatable access; low spend leaves room to test many hooks.

party.name: Crew games and quizzes
party.value: Several self-contained rounds create both a full episode and Shorts.

food.name: Food comparisons and constraints
food.value: Visible reactions and a ranking board supply repeated payoffs without a location change.

build.name: Backyard games and physical recreations
build.value: One reusable playing space supports multiple formats and Shorts.

meet-local.name: Local creator collaboration
meet-local.crew: Niz + collaborator; no assumed appearance fee
meet-local.value: Introduces a familiar creator through a concrete shared activity.

domestic.name: Domestic meetup or convention trip
domestic.crew: Niz + one production companion; one shared room
domestic.value: Batch a meetup episode, a challenge and several Shorts to spread fixed travel cost.

overnight.name: Local overnight or parked-car challenge
overnight.value: Time passing creates natural chapters; only retain changes that affect the challenge.

hotel.name: Budget-versus-premium hotel comparison
lines: Budget stay allowance; $1 title requires a documented subsidy
hotel.value: Matched tests make the contrast visible. A lower-cost pilot can use a $700–2,000 premium room, but must change the title and thumbnail to the actual paid prices.

setup.name: Gaming setup upgrade or gift
setup.value: The before-and-after and recipient payoff carry the episode; choose parts around a specific need.

product.name: Products, gadgets, toys or cosplay
product.value: Order a small, deliberate range with different testable claims; a large pile alone is not a story.

prize.name: $1,000 house competition
prize.value: A clear contest and actual payout make the stakes understandable.

location.name: Vet, shop or booked escape-room access
location.value: A real task and a professional correcting Niz create the progression; confirm filming access before scheduling.

editor.name: Paid subscriber editing challenge
editor.value: The before-and-after is the reveal; use the same source footage for a fair comparison.

morocco.name: Morocco identity trip
morocco.crew: Niz + one companion; assumed US departure, one room
morocco.value: Build the trip around specific personal stories and film several distinct episodes; fares depend on origin and dates.

road.name: Budget-car road trip
road.value: The purchase price is only one line item; set an actual viable route and reserve for repairs.

flight.name: Economy versus premium flight
flight.crew: Niz + companion; compare clearly specified cabin products
flight.value: Only book premium travel if the cabin comparison is the story; a meetup alone rarely needs it.

premium.name: Explicit $1,000 product / gift comparison
premium.value: Use real receipts and consistent tasks; disclose borrowed items and revise the title if spend differs.
